enemy_class_notes: Static map markers describe encounter loci, not a guaranteed spawned enemy tier.
Elite is a runtime stronger variant with additional affixes; no static E marker is emitted.
Operatives are co-op-only runtime enemies and therefore have no static map marker.
Mutation Agent is labeled A only for an exact authored actor; campaign horde anchors do not imply one.
Captain boss pits occur outside X-4; X-4 boss pits contain Destructors.

enemies.name: Pathogenic Vegevore
descriptions: Fires projectiles that inflicts a disease that can jump between nearby heroes.
enemies.behavior: Its projectile can apply the ranked disease, whose retained run spreads among nearby heroes subject to the authored immunity interval.

enemies.name: Menace Weed
descriptions: Roots to channel healing near allies; otherwise fires rapid thorns.
enemies.behavior: The ally-dependent phase selects its repeated six-unit heal aura or its ranked multishot Thorn Dart.

enemies.name: Mending Tanglid
descriptions: Heals badly hurt allies; roots heroes, calls nearby friends to attack them, and keeps away from heroes.
enemies.behavior: Its strict-below-half support branch heals first, its repeated close-range retreat keeps separation, and Entangle applies the ranked root and redirects all living allies inside 20 units to that victim.

enemies.name: Necrodactyl
descriptions: The curse deals damage over time, but has a limit on how much it can stack.
enemies.behavior: Projectile impacts apply the six-second curse, repeated hits refresh it and stack its damage only to the authored maximum of three.

enemies.name: Arachno Striker
descriptions: Slow homing projectiles terrify heroes, then it chases terrified victims into melee.
enemies.behavior: The projectile applies Fear and the phase selects close melee against the affected target.

enemies.name: Carrion Shambler
descriptions: Can consume the corpses of its allies to become larger and stronger.
Uses its large fists to smash heroes in melee range.
enemies.behavior: It claims and consumes eligible allied corpses, gaining stacked damage and body scale, and otherwise uses its multi-target frontal melee.

enemies.name: Ragetusk
descriptions: Charges and knocks heroes up; grows and deals more damage when nearby allies die.
enemies.behavior: The existing charge and knock-up remain, while each nearby allied death now adds a bounded damage and body-size enrage stack.

enemies.name: Dimensionist
descriptions: Creates a lasting sphere that slows heroes and projectiles, then calls debris down while protected.
enemies.behavior: Slow Shield uses a removable 16-second globe, Meteor flows into the authored 12-unit target-facing strafe, distant targets are pursued, and the intermediate range admits either packaged laugh/taunt animation.

enemies.name: Animus
descriptions: Resurrects nearby allies who have recently been killed.
In between resurrections, flees and throws ghostly projectiles.
enemies.behavior: It revives the nearest eligible encounter corpse at 40 percent health; without one, it backs away from a close hero and fires the ranked GhostlyBolt projectile before checking for another corpse. The flee pursuit is an explicit secondary phase, so the primary resurrection-family guard no longer releases it as incompatible.

enemies.name: Strafing Drakon
descriptions: Moves and attacks faster near members of its own species.
enemies.behavior: Another living Drakon inside ten units grants a 25-percent movement increase and 25-percent shorter attack cadence.

enemies.name: Haster
descriptions: Can bend time to haste a nearby ally's movement and attack speed.
Has a moderately damaging projectile attack.
enemies.behavior: It deterministically selects the nearest living ally inside range 30, falls back to itself only when alone, applies the exact 20-second movement/attack/cooldown haste, then fires its recovered projectile.
